name: com.github.doqltl179.mu3library.urp
description: URP (Universal Render Pipeline) extensions for Mu3Library. Requires com.github.doqltl179.mu3library.base and com.unity.render-pipelines.universal.

samples.description: URP screen effect sample scene and scripts for Mu3Library URP. Its scene responds to input with or without the Input System package, and its TextMesh Pro text renders in a player without the TMP Essential Resources.
